skills.mechanism: Ally attack buff (tomori mayoiuta precedent) + ally stress/stun/mark as cost.
gaps: One-consumption 'next attack only' is NOT expressible in data; approximated as a 1-round combat_stat_buff (attack_rating_add 150-210%, crit_chance_add 100%). Refresh/consumption semantics pending A7.
Ally stun (.stun 1) and ally mark (.tag on ally) have no direct mod precedent — inferred from ally-targeted effect writes (experimental).

skills.mechanism: Ally dotBleed + stress (ally dot precedent: TakiStress dotStress on ally target), self heal/healstress (soyo precedent).
gaps: Direct ally health damage (.health_damage) has NO precedent in any reference mod or documented boss skill; represented as dotBleed. Death's Door/protection interactions pending A11.

skills.mechanism: Other-allies stress via performer_group_other (tomori stress01-05 precedent). Enemy group stun via effect .target target_group (original MultiStun boss structure per design F22).
gaps: Party bleed is dotBleed (flat 10/1 round), not max-health percent — 20% max HP cost not expressible; fixed-value compromise documented in design §4.7.
Group stun once-per-target resolution and post-stun resistance ladder pending A12.

skills.mechanism: Self stress (uika precedent) + self dotBleed (mutsumi mortis_bleed precedent) to grant ONE extra action to the targeted ally via .initiative_change 1 (taki Taki_Extra_Action precedent — caster-target only there).
gaps: initiative_change on a non-caster ally target is community-flagged unreliable ('gets weird'); requires A10 runtime verification before trusting.

skills.mechanism: Other-allies resolve penalty via performer_group_other + buff_ids resolve_check_percent quest_end (tomori/soyo precedent; our buff refs are complete, no soyo dangling-ref bug). Caster extra action via .initiative_change 1 on performer (taki precedent).
gaps: DESIGN DEVIATION: persistent two-actions-per-round is not expressible in hero data (monster-only field, untested on heroes). Implemented as one extra action in the casting round, per_battle_limit 1. A14 experiment (hero info initiative constant) remains the only candidate for the full design; do NOT promote to permanent double actions.

runtime_checks: Dominion: does the 1-round buff survive the ally's stun turn? Does crit_chance_add 100% actually guarantee crits or is there a cap? Does repeated casting refresh or stack? (A7)
Survive/Quit: ally dotBleed tick timing, Death's Door interaction, protection, stress received modifiers. (A11)
Quit: each enemy stunned/resists independently; ally costs paid exactly once even when every enemy resists; multi-rank enemies do not double-pay. (A12)
Stage: initiative_change granted to an ally is reliable when that ally has/has not already acted this round; two casts do not stack into extra-extra actions. (A10)
Selfish: resolve penalty applied once per cast, stacks across battles, cleared at quest end, no effect on Sakiko herself; camping virtue buff coexists by engine rules. (A13)
Selfish: caster receives exactly one extra action in the casting round; no recursion, combat ends clean. (A14 partial)
